help_text:
NAVIGATION:

Channel Up/Down:
Swipe up or down to change channels. Channels wrap around when you reach the end.

Video Forward/Back:
Swipe left or right to skip to next or previous video in the current channel.

PLAYBACK CONTROLS:

Play/Pause:
Press the Play/Pause button to pause or resume playback.

Scrubbing (while paused):
Swipe left to rewind or right to fast-forward in 30-second increments. Repeated swipes increase the skip interval.

FILTERS:

Cycle Filters:
Press the center button on the trackpad to cycle through available video filters.

Auto-Cycle Filters:
Enable in Settings to automatically change filters at set intervals.

SETTINGS MENU:

Access this menu by pressing the Menu button. Navigate with up/down swipes and toggle options with left/right swipes or the center button.
about_text:
TELEVISION WASTELAND

This application presents curated video content sourced from the Internet Archive, a nonprofit digital library offering free access to historical media.

Video content is streamed directly from Internet Archive servers. All copyrights remain with their respective owners.

FILTER EFFECTS:
Many visual filters in this app are inspired by examples from Shadertoy (shadertoy.com), adapted to Metal and optimized for real-time video processing.

CONTENT TAKEDOWN REQUESTS:
If you are the copyright holder of content appearing in this app and wish to request its removal, please contact the Internet Archive directly at:

info@archive.org

To identify a specific video for takedown:
1. Enable Debug Mode using the menu option below
2. A QR code will appear linking to the video's Internet Archive page
3. Use this URL in your DMCA request
